_readme: Honest inventory of technical skills with confidence levels, evidence and gaps. Used by /interview-prep to decide what you can safely be grilled on, and by tailoring to avoid overselling weak skills.
Copy to data/technical_inventory.json and replace the fictional Alex Example content with your own. Evidence entries reference project ids from deep_experience.json or master_cv.json projects.

confidence_levels.can_explain_deeply: Could whiteboard it, discuss trade-offs, and answer follow-up questions confidently
confidence_levels.can_discuss: Comfortable in conversation, might stumble on edge cases or deep follow-ups
confidence_levels.surface_only: Knows the concepts and when to use it, but cannot go deep on implementation
confidence_levels.gap: Expected for target roles but weak; needs upskilling or honest framing

SQL.details: Daily use for 3 years: joins, window functions, CTEs, reconciliation queries against the CRM and finance databases.

Python.details: Primary tool for 3 years: Pandas pipelines, API integration, scheduled jobs, plus two side projects built end to end.

JavaScript.details: Used only for the React frontend of the budgeting app. Can read and modify code but would struggle with a JS-specific interview.

Power BI.details: Built and maintains 12 production dashboards: data model design, DAX measures, row-level security, refresh scheduling.

Forecasting / regression.details: Built one production demand forecasting model (scikit-learn) and an econometrics dissertation. Solid on regression fundamentals; weaker on time-series specifics like SARIMA.

A/B testing.details: Understands the theory from coursework but has never run a real experiment. Frame as a learning goal, never claim hands-on experience.

Git / CI.details: Uses Git daily and set up GitHub Actions CI for both side projects. Comfortable with branching and pull requests; no experience with large-team workflows.

Cloud platforms.details: Side projects run on a single VPS. No AWS/GCP/Azure production experience; a known gap for data engineering adjacent roles.

critical_for_target_roles: Cloud platforms (AWS/GCP); expected for many analytics engineering roles
A/B testing; expected for product analyst roles
